title: Hooked on UFOs by Chariots of the Gods

tellings.quote: you have to go back to 1969, I believe it was. And when when I read um Chariots of the Gods by Eric von Donakin, I was hooked.

plain: A NASA doctor named Greg Rogers says his interest in UFOs began in 1969, "I believe it was," when he read Chariots of the Gods, Erich von Däniken's book arguing that visitors from space came to Earth in ancient times. "I was hooked," he tells Michels, explaining how a man who later says he saw a UFO in a secret hangar first came to the subject.
